title: Audit four-player Survival feasibility and resource limits
goal: Map every two-player assumption and propose the smallest correct four-player implementation for local, online and mixed play.
acceptance: Identify fixed arrays, scripts, spawn/revive, AI, rewards/profiles, HUD/cameras and packet layouts with exact-build evidence
Prototype four distinct player states and measure memory/CPU/GPU cost; preserve original two-player fallback; estimate real remaining work
validation: Run controlled four-slot state probe with failure cases
Compare two- and four-view rendering and late-wave load when available
